The story
故事

In the Light Heights — the high, silent valleys of the northwest — a goatherd named Sela hears something on the wind that she cannot explain. She will not pretend to more than she knows, and she will not take back what she does. In a realm sworn to ten great houses, that plainness is its own kind of danger.
在 the Light Heights——西北那些高耸而寂静的山谷——一名叫 Sela 的牧羊女在风中听见了她无法解释的东西。 她不愿假装知道得比自己所知更多，也不愿收回自己所说 的话。在一个立誓效忠于十大家族的国度，这份坦率本身 就是一种危险。

The testing of what she heard falls to Brother Tomas, a man carrying the one
        thing a tester should not own — his first doubt. Above them both stands Mother
        Alaine, half a lifetime in the listening house, keeper of more memory than any
        record holds. Beyond the mountains, the ten houses are already gathering their
        testimony for a four-hundred-year jubilee, and a chronicler is coming to write
        the valley down.

对她所听之物的考验落到了 Tomas 修士身上，这个人怀揣着一名
        考验者本不该拥有的东西——他的第一份怀疑。凌驾于两人之上的是
        Alaine 嬷嬷，半生都在这座聆听之屋中度过，守护着比任何
        记录都更多的记忆。群山之外，十大家族已在为一场四百年的
        大庆典搜集各自的证言，而一名编年者正动身前来，要把
        这座山谷记录下来。
The Bell of Silence asks one question and refuses to make it easy: what do you do with a truth you cannot prove — and a silence everyone else insists on reading for you?
The Bell of Silence 提出了一个问题，并拒绝把它变得容易： 面对一个你无法证明的真相——以及一段所有人都 坚持要替你解读的沉默——你会怎么做？

What you can expect
你可以期待什么
A grounded, human epic fantasy told at the scale of one valley and one testing.
一部脚踏实地、充满人性的史诗奇幻，以一座山谷与一场考验的尺度娓娓道来。
Ten great houses, each a different wager about what people are for.
十大家族，每一个都是关于人为何而存在的不同赌注。
A story about testimony, memory, and the cost of an honest answer.
一个关于证言、记忆，以及一个诚实答案所需付出代价的故事。
An interlude that steps outside the valley — to the desks where its story is being decided.
一段跳出山谷之外的插曲——通往那些正在决定它命运的书案之前。
